cpoe.formula: (complete or dropped attempts)/all non-stall attempts - mean available cp
cpoe.individualFormula: (1 for complete or dropped, otherwise 0) - cp; missing cp stays null
cpoe.rawFieldWarning: Stored per-throw cpoe is 1 on recorded drops. Do not average it.
